Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. The team at Clipper Health is ready to see Redwood in action. Would you be able to run a 45-minute demo next week? Our preferred slot is:

  • Mon, Dec 28 at 10:00 AM PT (we'll invite 6 people: product, ops, SRE)

If that doesn't work, we can also do Tue, Dec 29 afternoon. We want to focus on: dedicated capacity options, SSO/data handling notes, and a short Q&A on batching/cost controls.

Hi Andrew —

Really excited to run this for Clipper Health. Quick note on timing: Redwood has a company-wide winter operations window (Dec 30 — Jan 3) and several members of the engineering demos squad are traveling for a conference the week of Dec 27 (short staffing). That makes the Dec 28/29 slots risky.

Two options that should work well:

  1) Live demo: Tue, Jan 11 at 9:00 AM PT (45 min) — can include a short deep-dive with engineering.
  2) Asynchronous option: we can record a 20–25 minute tailored demo + a 30-minute live Q&A with a solutions engineer during the week of Jan 11 (less people's time but still interactive).

I'll attach a short one-pager and a tentative invite (ICS). If you prefer to keep something in the next week, we can do an async recording + async Q&A via Slack or email, but it won't include a live engineering segment.

Next steps: tell me which option you prefer and which dates/times work for your group.

Cheers,
Hannah Schmitt
